meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 啰嗦的回复压成简短回答，省下输出开销还保住技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 AI 回答总是长篇大论，你只想看要点。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink AI replies into short answers while keeping the technical points intact.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI answers ramble on and you just want the key points.

howto.what: Claude 的回复会切成极简体风格:去掉冠词、客套话和填充词,但技术术语、数字、代码块保持原样。整个会话持续这种风格,直到你关掉。
howto.when: 当你说 /caveman、“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”,或要求 “be brief”、“less tokens” 时触发。可用 /caveman lite|full|ultra|wenyan-*|off 切换档位。

say.text: 用 caveman lite 讲讲这个报错

howto.what_en: Claude replies in ultra-terse style: drops articles, filler and pleasantries, keeps technical terms, numbers and code blocks exact. Style persists all session until turned off.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens". Switch levels with /caveman lite|full|ultra|wenyan-*|off.

say_en.text: Explain this error in caveman lite
